source.raw_prompt: format_page_label() should reject negative page numbers instead of silently formatting them.

objective: Fix format_page_label() in fixture-src/helpers.py so it raises ValueError for a negative page_number instead of silently formatting it.
constraints: No new dependencies without written justification.
